+import json, tempfile, os, uuid
+from mlflow.store.tracking.sqlalchemy_store import SqlAlchemyStore
+from mlflow.entities.issue import IssueSeverity, IssueStatus
+from mlflow.store.tracking.dbmodels.models import SqlAssessments, SqlTraceInfo
+
+db = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".db", delete=False)
+uri = f"sqlite:///{db.name}"
+store = SqlAlchemyStore(uri, default_artifact_root=tempfile.mkdtemp())
+
+exp_id = store.create_experiment("test-issues")
+
+# Create issues with varying severities
+hi1 = store.create_issue(exp_id, "hi1", "d", severity=IssueSeverity.HIGH)
+hi2 = store.create_issue(exp_id, "hi2", "d", severity=IssueSeverity.HIGH)
+med = store.create_issue(exp_id, "med", "d", severity=IssueSeverity.MEDIUM)
+low = store.create_issue(exp_id, "low", "d", severity=IssueSeverity.LOW)
+
+def link_traces(issue_id, n):
+    with store.ManagedSessionMaker() as session:
+        for i in range(n):
+            tid = f"tr-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
+            session.add(SqlTraceInfo(
+                request_id=tid, experiment_id=int(exp_id),
+                timestamp_ms=1, execution_time_ms=1, status="OK",
+            ))
+            session.add(SqlAssessments(
+                assessment_id=f"a-{uuid.uuid4().hex}", trace_id=tid,
+                name=issue_id, assessment_type="issue", source_type="LLM_JUDGE", source_id="j",
+                value=json.dumps({"issue_name": "x"}),
+                created_timestamp=1, last_updated_timestamp=1,
+            ))
+
+# hi1 -> 2 traces, hi2 -> 5 traces, med -> 3 traces, low -> 0 traces
+link_traces(hi1.issue_id, 2)
+link_traces(hi2.issue_id, 5)
+link_traces(med.issue_id, 3)
+
+print("=== include_trace_count=False ===")
+res = store.search_issues(experiment_id=exp_id)
+for i in res:
+    print(i.name, i.severity, "trace_count=", i.trace_count)
+assert all(i.trace_count is None for i in res), "expected None"
+
+print("=== include_trace_count=True ===")
+res = store.search_issues(experiment_id=exp_id, include_trace_count=True)
+order = [(i.name, i.trace_count) for i in res]
+print(order)
+# Expected: HIGH sorted by trace_count desc: hi2(5), hi1(2); then MEDIUM med(3); then LOW low(0)
+assert order == [("hi2",5),("hi1",2),("med",3),("low",0)], order
+assert all(isinstance(i.trace_count, int) for i in res)
+assert low.issue_id
+assert [i for i in res if i.name=="low"][0].trace_count == 0
+
+print("=== pagination ===")
+p1 = store.search_issues(experiment_id=exp_id, include_trace_count=True, max_results=2)
+print("page1", [(i.name,i.trace_count) for i in p1], "token=", bool(p1.token))
+p2 = store.search_issues(experiment_id=exp_id, include_trace_count=True, max_results=2, page_token=p1.token)
+print("page2", [(i.name,i.trace_count) for i in p2])
+assert [(i.name,i.trace_count) for i in p1] == [("hi2",5),("hi1",2)]
+assert [(i.name,i.trace_count) for i in p2][0] == ("med",3)
+assert all(isinstance(i.trace_count,int) for i in list(p1)+list(p2))
+
+print("=== filter + include_trace_count ===")
+store.update_issue(hi2.issue_id, status=IssueStatus.RESOLVED)
+resf = store.search_issues(experiment_id=exp_id, include_trace_count=True, filter_string="status = 'resolved'")
+print([(i.name,i.trace_count,str(i.status)) for i in resf])
+assert [(i.name,i.trace_count) for i in resf] == [("hi2",5)]
+
+print("\nALL ASSERTIONS PASSED")
